description: Kuli is an AI coworker for marketing teams at the world's largest consumer brands, analyzing social media videos to enhance campaign effectiveness.
funding_summary: Kuli has raised approximately €500K in 2026 and participated in Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch.
inflection_why_now: The increasing reliance on AI for marketing efficiency and the growing volume of social media content create a timely opportunity for Kuli's solution.
devils_advocate_risks: Challenges in scaling AI capabilities to handle vast amounts of social media data.
Potential resistance from traditional marketing teams to adopt AI-driven processes.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Evonik specializes in digitalization and AI solutions for industrial applications, aligning with Kuli's AI-driven marketing platform.
SAP's focus on enterprise software and AI integration complements Kuli's AI solutions for marketing teams.
